title: Short video card (TikTok-style)
description: A paused portrait short video in a TikTok-style feed. The poster frame comes from the image slot; the caption, on-screen text, sound line and counts are drawn as real text over it. Captions are short and casual, with a run of hashtags at the end.

timestampRel.description: Post age shown after the handle

caption.description: Caption under the handle; #hashtags and @mentions are highlighted. One or two short sentences.
examples: Screens just died across the whole concourse and nobody will tell us anything #NCIA #stuck

overlayText.description: Text sticker drawn over the video (the creator's on-screen caption), a few words
examples: POV: every screen in the airport goes black

soundName.description: Sound line at the bottom; defaults to 'original sound - <handle>'

viewCount.description: Views: a number (abbreviated automatically, 48300 → 48.3K) or the exact text

durationSec.description: Clip length in seconds, shown on the progress bar

thumbnailBrief.description: Image-generation brief for the poster frame (media stage only; portrait 9:16 phone video still; never rely on legible text in it)
examples: crowded airport concourse with dark departure screens, shaky vertical phone video still

videoBrief.description: Optional brief for a short clip of the same scene (media stage only, when the row asks for footage)
examples: handheld vertical phone video panning across dark gate screens, people pointing
